title: The Lie group-Lie algebra correspondence in tangent categories
summary: Classic Lie theory establishes a correspondence between Lie groups, which are internal group objects in the category of smooth manifolds, and Lie algebras. An analogous correspondence also exists for group objects in affine schemes. Both smooth manifolds and affine schemes form tangent categories, which provide a categorical context for differential geometry. Therefore, it is natural to ask whether the Lie correspondence can be constructed entirely from the tangent structure.
